18:30 │ EN VIVO AHORA: Women's College Basketball
The No. 7 Louisville Cardinals play the No. 4 UConn Huskies. Louisville looks to extend an undefeated start after holding Lindenwood to 35 points, while UConn relies on 11 three-pointers from a 12-point win on Nov. 9 to earn an away victory.

20:30 │ A CONTINUACIÓN: 2027 WNBA Draft Lottery
The WNBA holds its annual lottery to decide the order teams will make picks in the 2027 WNBA Draft. Six teams will participate in this year's lottery, as Houston, Toronto, Washington, Seattle, Portland and Los Angeles vie for the number 1 pick.
